questions.question:
Given below are three statements followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Considering the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which conclusion(s) logically follows from the statements.

**Statement:**

All apples are bananas.

All grapes are bananas.

All bananas are plums.

**Conclusion:**

I. All apples are plums.

II. All grapes are plums.

III. Some grapes are bananas.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17fcb4f1a1775974d7895642eb497d9cc78a48057a48f6068420bbc1c80bc362.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All apples are plums → Follow (As all apples are bananas and all bananas are plums. So, as whole apples comes in bananas which whole comes in plums therefore it is definitely true)

II. All grapes are plums → Follow (As all grapes are bananas and all bananas are plums. So, as whole grapes comes in bananas which whole comes in plums therefore it is definitely true)

III. Some grapes are bananas → Follow (As all grapes are bananas. So, as whole grapes comes in bananas therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, all conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**All conclusions follow**".

questions.question: Kirti, Suman, Shubh, Kanak, Pari, Charu, Shlok and Shivi are sitting around a square table facing towards the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting right in the middle of the sides. Kirti is sitting third to the left of Shubh. Kirti is sitting at one of the corners. Kanak is sitting second to the right of Pari. Pari is not sitting at any corner. Pari is not sitting immediately next to Kirti. Suman is sitting immediately next to Charu. Suman is not sitting exactly in the middle of any side. Only three persons sit between Suman and Shlok. Who is sitting second to the right of Shivi?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

 
• Kirti, Suman, Shubh, Kanak, Pari, Charu, Shlok and Shivi are sitting around a square table facing towards the center of the table.
 
• Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting right in the middle of the sides.

**Explanation : **

1) Kirti is sitting third to the left of Shubh.

2) Kirti is sitting at one of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6d12104ac6c56e27539f02a3526e6ae49e8f456f7fe87a47688a67c632d529c.png] 

3) Pari is not sitting at any corner.

4) Pari is not sitting immediately next to Kirti.

5) Kanak is sitting second to the right of Pari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41970ae31daeaa7dfb409b544e8c4373fbefc93318a210159b2b731b6f4027b3.png] 

6) Suman is sitting immediately next to Charu.

7) Suman is not sitting exactly in the middle of any side.

8) Only three persons sit between Suman and Shlok.

As after positioning Charu, Suman and Shlok only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Shivi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a8388d5165875123a468f2c5b5ba77ec6636f1e2fa1cf00442cf3cdb6ee48c5.png] 

Here, according to the final arrangement Shlok is sitting second to the right of Shivi.

Hence, **"Shlok"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86eb13fb31201ea1a28a56f0790ae677af0024430c317d9cf1aa450e912c9562.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 6 is common on both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 2, 3, 4 and 5 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa86fd980ef291e93331dc5d23458f2c05cd0102976fae2d1349069a63b5a4fa.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 6

2 → 5

3 → 4

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "1".
